title: fix(spec): record:chatter / record:discussion position speaks the renderer's vocabulary; the row's schema defaults are dropped (#8762)
body:
Fixes #8762

Implements the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-15 (「接受全部建议。」, four binding points in issue comment `5299771841`): the `record:chatter` / `record:discussion` `position` vocabulary converges on the renderer's, the old spellings take an ADR-0087 conversion, all three schema defaults are dropped, and the row stays ONE shared schema object for the pair.

⚠️ **This PR touches the ADR-0087 registry surfaces** (`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json`, `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`) — landing runs the os-regen relay if a sibling registration lands first.

## What changed

**`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (`RecordChatterProps` — the shared chatter/discussion row):**

- `position` is now `z.enum(['bottom', 'right', 'left'])` — the renderer's own vocabulary, no mapping layer. The three old spellings (`sidebar`/`inline`/`drawer`) are refused with a per-value prescription carried by the enum's own error map keyed on `issue.input` (the `view.exportOptions` `'pdf'` precedent from #8010 — an enum-VALUE narrowing has no `retiredKey()` tombstone to hang the prescription on).
- All three schema defaults dropped (`position: 'sidebar'`, `collapsible: true`, `defaultCollapsed: false`) per the `maxVisible` principle: the keys are now `.optional()` with the renderer default named in the `.describe()` prose. The dropped `position` default was itself half of defect 1; the dropped `collapsible` default *inverted* the renderer merge's `false` fallback.
- `width`'s describe prose no longer names the retired `sidebar`/`drawer` vocabulary — it now says side positions (`right`/`left`) only.
- The pair identity is untouched: `ComponentPropsMap['record:discussion']` is still the same object as `ComponentPropsMap['record:chatter']` (pinned by the existing #8744 test, which still passes).

**Renderer facts, re-measured in this worktree at objectui pin `665661ab0932`** (the card's numbers verified, with one nuance stated precisely):

- `RecordChatterPanel.tsx:88-96`: `position ?? 'right'`, branches `right`/`left` (docked side panel) vs `bottom` (in-flow); `collapsible ?? true`, `defaultCollapsed ?? false`.
- `renderers/record-chatter.tsx:43-52`: merges `{ position: 'bottom', collapsible: false, feed: {…}, ...schema }` — so for every registry-rendered (i.e. authored) component the effective fallbacks are `bottom` / `false`; the panel's own `?? 'right'` / `?? true` are unreachable for those keys because the merge always supplies them. The auto-appended panel (`RecordDetailView.tsx:2347-2356`) passes `position: 'bottom', collapsible: false` explicitly. The panel's `defaultCollapsed ?? false` IS live (no caller supplies it).
- Registration `CHATTER_INPUTS` (`plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:468-474`): `enum: ['bottom', 'right', 'left'], defaultValue: 'bottom'`, `collapsible` defaultValue `false`, width described "side positions only".

So the renderer is self-consistent in three places and the spec row was the isolated wrong party — the ruling's convergence direction, confirmed by measurement.

**ADR-0087 conversion** (`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, id `record-chatter-position-vocabulary`, `toMajor: 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath: true` — the post-cut class, same as `field-malformed-scale-precision-removed`):

Value-level rewrite scoped by component type (`record:chatter` / `record:discussion`), walking `mapPageComponents` (regions, slots, JSX carriers). Mapping preserves **author intent** against the renderer's branch semantics (`right|left` ⇒ docked, `bottom` ⇒ in-flow):

- `sidebar` → `right`: the author asked for a docked side panel; `right` is the conventional chatter side and the panel's own docked default. Observed behaviour changes — the value used to fall through to the in-flow render — but the fall-through was the defect, not the intent.
- `inline` → `bottom`: intent and observed behaviour agree; nothing visible changes.
- `drawer` → `right`: no renderer branch ever implemented an overlay drawer, so this is a removal with a nearest-intent target — a side drawer's surviving shape is the docked side panel.

Fixture includes a non-chatter component carrying `position: 'sidebar'` (must survive byte-identically — the conversion is scoped by type) and an already-canonical `left` (untouched).

**Semantic entry** (`entries/semantic/18.record-chatter-position-vocabulary-converged.ts`): carries the two judgements the chain cannot make — whether `drawer` → `right` is the presentation the author wants, and whether a page that relied on the old materialized `collapsible: true` default should now author it explicitly.

**Default-change ledger** (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts`): three entries under major 17 declaring the dropped defaults, as `check:authorable-surface` requires — each with the deployed-behaviour analysis (the `position` and `defaultCollapsed` drops move no deployed behaviour; the `collapsible` drop is the one whose old materialized value a page may have relied on).

**Step 18 registry** (`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`): conversion id appended to `conversionIds`, rationale extended; semantic entry inserted by `gen:migration-registry`. Projections re-run: `gen:spec-changes` / `gen:upgrade-guide` / `gen:api-surface` came back **byte-identical** — the projections exclude protocol-18 steps until the major cut, which is the post-cut precedents' expected shape (the `field-malformed-scale-precision-removed` registration projects the same way); `check:generated` proves all 13 artifacts current. The real diffs are the authorable-surface defaults shard (`authorable-defaults/ui.json`) and the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`.

**Tests** (fixture triage per the three dispositions):

- REPLACED wholesale: the "accept empty with defaults" pins (they pinned exactly the removed limb — their assertions would have kept passing only because nothing is produced) → no-default pins: `parse({})` output has no `position`/`collapsible`/`defaultCollapsed` keys, on `RecordChatterProps` and through `ComponentPropsMap['record:chatter']`.
- RE-SPELLED: `position: 'sidebar'`/`'drawer'` fixtures that merely used the old vocabulary → `'right'`/`'bottom'`.
- ADDED: per-value rejection pins (`invalid_value` code + path + "was removed" message naming the replacement and `os migrate meta`) for each retired spelling; a never-legal value (`modal`) pinned to get zod's plain enum refusal, NOT a retirement prescription; positive pins for all three accepted values through both names; pair-identity refusal pin (both names produce the identical prescription).
- Conversion fixture is auto-driven by the existing `conversions.test.ts` harness (before → after + notice count), and the retired-entry invariants (load path skips it, stored-row seam replays it) apply to it via the existing `ALL_CONVERSIONS` loops.

**Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec: minor` (post-cut lockstep launch-window convention, same as `field-scale-precision-integer-refused`), FROM→TO table, and the ADR-0087 disposition marker `adr-0087: registered record-chatter-position-vocabulary, record-chatter-position-vocabulary-converged` (spelled here without its HTML-comment brackets — the body sanitizer eats those; the real marker lives in the changeset file).

## Consumer sweep

Grep for `'sidebar'`/`'inline'`/`'drawer'`/`record:chatter`/`record:discussion` across `packages/`, `examples/` found the old vocabulary authored ONLY in `packages/spec`'s own tests (updated here). No example app authors the pair; other `sidebar`/`inline` hits are different surfaces (`page:sidebar`, region names, form modes, storage disposition). objectui keeps its own vocabulary unchanged — no objectui edits from this card.

## Reverse verification

Direction decided before running: restoring the old enum line makes the three rejection pins go red (old spellings accepted again) and the no-default pins go red (`position: 'sidebar'` materialized) — see the tests section of the report for the observed run.
